I'll go with this one — the whole card opening the link.

My reasoning: it gives me a big, forgiving target. When I'm scanning my list and spot the one I want, I can just click it anywhere on the body and it opens — I don't have to aim precisely at the title text. And the little "Open original ↗" cue makes it clear that clicking the card is what takes me to the page, so it isn't a mystery. It still opened in a new tab with my collection staying put, which is the part that matters most.

The thing I care about most held up in both versions: the read-later button and the "•••" menu stay independent, so clicking to open the page never accidentally flags something for later or pops the menu. As long as those controls remain their own separate islands on the card, the whole-card click is the one I prefer.
